identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][tooling] Keep all issue lifecycle writes in the bound worktree

values.goal: Make typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle writes materialize and operate from the declared bound worktree instead of dirtying the primary checkout.
values.required_outcome: Binding and later doctor/validate/review/publish/closeout use the same issue worktree root, while primary-main lifecycle writes fail closed outside explicit bootstrap/read-only paths.
authority_boundary: Issue #5658 owns only typed v2 lifecycle-root behavior and focused regressions
Existing issue records and #5655 are preserved
Root main cleanup is not part of implementation
operator_constraints: Rust binaries only; no Python or shell lifecycle wrapper
